body:
Root cause: the two-pane mail UI was wrapped in the same generic .card as simple settings forms, and a global 960px content cap centered everything, producing a small floating card with huge empty gutters on wide viewports. Removed the global cap (SIP/Account pages get their own .narrow-card instead); mail's two-pane view is now a flush panel filling the full content area. Deployed live (static-only change). Commit 172c1cf.

⚓ ☃
title: Console: mail view now a full-bleed panel matching the /design mockup, not a floating narrow card
